ref: IMG_4408 f037 (square-on, squared up), f010 (oblique letter/depth detail)
notes: Black flat-cut letters (~5 cm deep, glossy black faces) on the white tiled portal wall of the old Sears mall entrance, unlit; flanked by lantern sconces (not part of the sign). 'Lynn's' script traced from f037 (palm fronds cross the far left of the L's swash, so its very left tip is a best guess). 'INTERIORS' is a bold Roman serif set in Liberation Serif Bold condensed to fit (the real O is a little rounder); the thin rule above it is a separate flat bar. Size from the 3.0 m opening: ~2.7 m wide, script ~1.2 m tall, caps ~0.29 m.
